title: Banadir Heat-Health Action Preparedness and Management Plan (HHAMP) - Banadir, Somalia
organization: Ministry of Health & Human Services – Federal Government of Somalia, International Medical Corps
landscapes: Arid, Healthcare, Household, Institutional, Occupational, Urban
description: The Banadir Heat-Health Action Preparedness and Management Plan is a multi-sectoral initiative that addresses extreme heat through coordinated action across communities, health systems and local institutions. It focuses on strengthening health facility preparedness, community awareness and risk communication, early warning and response systems, occupational protection for health workers, and monitoring and evaluation, with specific attention paid to internally displaced populations (IDPs) and other vulnerable groups. The plan is designed to serve as a localized model for heat-health preparedness that can be scaled to surrounding districts in the Banadir region, with annual review and updates on the plan based on new data, stakeholder feedback, and evolving climatic conditions.
